'''Trass''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] and a member of a [[Unidentified resistance group (backwater planet)|resistance group]] on a [[Unidentified backwater planet|backwater planet]]. She took part in the [[mission to Sunfall Peak]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]. She cased the [[Imperial communications hub]] [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] before the raid.<ref name="Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook" />

==Behind the scenes==
Trass appears in the opening short story of the [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'' Core Rulebook]] released by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2014]]. She was also later used as a player's character in an example of gameplay given later in the book.<ref name="Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook" />
